subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A reply-extraction boundary, where transcript artifacts and message-tool mirrors stop announce/ping-pong delivery instead of being treated as fresh assistant replies?
rationale: The patch looks correct and well-proven, but the final choice is a maintainer-owned message-delivery invariant because it decides which transcript rows are deliverable across A2A handoffs.

options.title: Accept the artifact barrier
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers agree transcript bookkeeping rows must never drive waited A2A announce or ping-pong delivery.

options.title: Require live channel proof
options.body: Ask for one additional redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if qa-channel proof is not enough for this delivery boundary.

options.title: Pause for broader A2A ordering
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want to land the reverse sessions_send or compaction fixes first and re-evaluate the combined behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the artifact barrier
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers agree transcript bookkeeping rows must never drive waited A2A announce or ping-pong delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns both sessions_send delayed replies and delivery mirror transcript identity, which are the two surfaces this decision joins.
